purpose: Second-pass exploratory review derived from Reid's recurring corrections. Run only after deterministic gates pass; promote every credible finding into a reproducible automated regression before retrying.

prompts.source_correction: Do not put an interactive overlay on top of the original screenshot.
prompts.review_prompt: Hide or move each editable layer in turn. Is any part of the original reference screenshot still acting as the runtime background or supplying duplicate controls?
prompts.promotion_rule: Turn any suspected underlay into a reproducible asset-request or hide-layer test before revision.

prompts.source_correction: Every header, icon, button, label, slider, checkbox, and panel must be independent and editable.
prompts.review_prompt: Can every semantic element be selected, moved, hidden, and replaced without carrying a neighbor or exposing a baked duplicate?
prompts.promotion_rule: Turn every fused region into a reproducible manifest-coverage failure before splitting it.

prompts.source_correction: Keep to the Japanese, and do not replace pixel-styled Japanese with a smooth text overlay.
prompts.review_prompt: Compare wording, glyph footprint, antialiasing, weight, spacing, and baseline against the source at high zoom. Does any Japanese text look newly typeset or stylistically foreign?
prompts.promotion_rule: Turn each mismatch into a reproducible OCR, font-readback, or local pixel-region assertion.

prompts.source_correction: Remove the pink background and the pink border around labels and the BGM and Effect window.
prompts.review_prompt: Inspect one-to-three-pixel rings around the window and every extracted element over dark and light contrast plates. Did any magenta donor pixel, rectangular crop edge, or neighbor color travel with it?
prompts.promotion_rule: Turn each colored seam into a reproducible forbidden-color or alpha-ring test before re-isolation.

prompts.source_correction: The edges of the windows are too cropped and do not preserve the original rounding.
prompts.review_prompt: Inspect every corner and one-to-three-pixel perimeter at high zoom. Did cleanup delete the original stepped corner, flatten the border, or replace a rounded source edge with a hard rectangular crop?
prompts.promotion_rule: Turn every flattened or over-cropped perimeter into a reproducible corner-alpha and border-occupancy assertion before revision.

prompts.source_correction: When I click a checkbox it moves, and there is a random black pixel above the bottom checkboxes.
prompts.review_prompt: Toggle every checkbox twice. Is its outer geometry invariant, and do before/after difference pixels stay inside the declared state region with no dead pixel above it?
prompts.promotion_rule: Turn any motion or stray pixel into a reproducible geometry-invariance and clear-row test.

prompts.source_correction: The on label is overlapped by the checkbox.
prompts.review_prompt: At both checkbox states, do the checkbox and its Japanese or on label occupy disjoint declared boxes while matching source spacing?
prompts.promotion_rule: Turn any overlap into a reproducible bounding-box intersection assertion.

prompts.source_correction: The top header Japanese is misplaced and there is a weird white box around it.
prompts.review_prompt: Compare the title glyph origin, baseline, surrounding transparency, and title-bar texture. Is the title displaced or enclosed by a new rectangular fill?
prompts.promotion_rule: Turn title drift or a box into a reproducible local-geometry and perimeter-pixel test.

prompts.source_correction: The minimize button does not regenerate the UI; it just crops it. There needs to be a generation pass.
prompts.review_prompt: Is the minimized endpoint a coherent independent surface with Qwen provenance, or merely the top strip of the expanded window with its body clipped?
prompts.promotion_rule: Turn crop equivalence or missing provenance into a reproducible endpoint-difference and provenance test.

prompts.source_correction: Generated interaction states and animations must remain complete rather than loading as blank or partial UI.
prompts.review_prompt: At every minimize animation frame and at the settled compact endpoint, are the window-specific Japanese title, icon, and right-end controls still visible, independently editable, and aligned to the generated chrome?
prompts.promotion_rule: Turn every blank or partial compact state into a reproducible title-authority visibility, endcap alignment, and restore-geometry test before revising assembly.

prompts.source_correction: The button mapping on info and options is not correct to the tab.
prompts.review_prompt: Click the center and both sides of every tab boundary. Does each pixel activate only the visually corresponding tab and show the correct panel?
prompts.promotion_rule: Turn every ambiguous pixel into a reproducible hit-map ownership assertion.

prompts.source_correction: Some sliders moved to the right do not go fully to the end and have a grey thing.
prompts.review_prompt: Drive every range to minimum and maximum by keyboard, arrows, and dragging. Does the visual thumb center reach both source endpoints without a native grey thumb or rectangular donor crop?
prompts.promotion_rule: Turn every inset or grey block into a reproducible endpoint-center and native-thumb-visibility test.

prompts.source_correction: The slider was choppy and not fully smooth because there were only four frames.
prompts.review_prompt: Replay slow and fast drags plus direction reversal. Are there more than four distinct values and enough distinct visual positions to look continuous?
prompts.promotion_rule: Turn discontinuity into a reproducible sample-count, monotonicity, or interruption test.

prompts.source_correction: Pay attention to what happens when buttons are pressed; all buttons must be interactable.
prompts.review_prompt: Inventory every enabled button. After pointer-down feedback settles and focus is removed where appropriate, does each action produce a meaningful visible or application-state change?
prompts.promotion_rule: Turn each dead or focus-only response into a reproducible before-after signature test.

prompts.source_correction: Pay attention to movement cutting off and movable window panel interactions.
prompts.review_prompt: Drag the window beyond every host edge, across every overlapping window, then minimize and restore it. Does it stay recoverable, rise predictably, and avoid cutting off body or controls?
prompts.promotion_rule: Turn each cutoff or stacking surprise into a reproducible containment or z-order sequence test.

prompts.source_correction: Japanese text must conform to the pixelated aesthetic and not overlap.
prompts.review_prompt: At every state and menu choice, does text remain within its source-shaped region, avoid neighboring controls, and preserve the pixel aesthetic?
prompts.promotion_rule: Turn any collision or style drift into a reproducible containment, OCR, or local-pixel assertion.

prompts.source_correction: Figma prototypes were not using the full advantage of linking and page viewing.
prompts.review_prompt: Do all runtime states have stable Figma counterparts, correct prototype reactions, root-relative coordinates, and links that navigate to the intended page or overlay?
prompts.promotion_rule: Turn each drift into a reproducible reaction, geometry-readback, or stable-ID parity test.

prompts.source_correction: A user is not a screenshot; the user goes in, inputs, clicks things, and does things.
prompts.review_prompt: Complete the window's realistic user journey using only user inputs, including reversal, cancel, reopen, and recovery. Is any required state unreachable despite passing screenshots?
prompts.promotion_rule: Turn every unreachable or inconsistent state into a reproducible end-to-end user-flow test.

prompts.source_correction: Many generated interaction states and animations are still not done.
prompts.review_prompt: Replay every state-changing control from idle through pointer-down, transition, settled, reversal, and restore. Does the response use a complete source-fitting state or generated endpoint, and does motion expose enough distinct frames without clipping, fading to an unrelated surface, or substituting a generic asset from another window?
prompts.promotion_rule: Turn every missing, generic, or visually foreign state and every choppy transition into a reproducible state-hash, sample-count, and clipping test before revision.
